scope: Full native window and raw actual Main world SubViewport. Controlled teleported cameras/actors, enemy AI/player physics disabled, simulation paused only for photographs. projection_coordinate_correction.reason: Original capture compared native SubViewport marker coordinates with full-window crosshair coordinates.
projection_coordinate_correction.method: Apply actual Main integer viewport enlargement and centered world-image rectangle from recorded window/native dimensions.
